# Imadi Technologies

> Imadi Technologies builds custom software and AI-assisted automation for growing
> businesses, and also builds its own products — starting with Maflow, a business
> management platform for growing companies.

## Products

- [Maflow](https://imadi-technologies.com/products/): Business management SaaS — quotations, delivery challans, invoices, sales tax invoices, purchases, customers, suppliers, products, payments, expenses, and a running ledger in one workspace.
- [Products overview](https://imadi-technologies.com/products/): All Imadi products and client-built systems, including Maflow, ALICO Business Suite, Imadi Logistics ERP, ReNaz, and the Child-Friendly City Index prototype.
